title: Piritori to Eden — Era I vertical slice

battles.objective: No stakes: read formations, weapon reach and cover against a fixed set that holds position. Leave whenever the read is done.

encounters.opening: A seller keeps the small bag in his pocket. The tram unloads twice while Aatami watches who stays.

choices.label: Buy one pack — €45
choices.forecast: Gain stock and the €68 Siltasaari demand lead; become a known customer.

choices.label: Ask who keeps watching
choices.forecast: Keep cash, gain a faction lead, spend the block.

choices.label: Walk away
choices.forecast: Preserve cash. The offer returns at night with a colder reception.

encounters.fallback: A deferred purchase reappears at the next safe Piritori visit; refusal reshapes the opening but cannot soft-lock the slice.

choices.label: Ask before taking the envelope
choices.forecast: Gain dead money and preserve trust.

choices.label: Call it family money
choices.forecast: Gain dead money; Jaska remembers the wording.

choices.label: Leave the old money under the map
choices.forecast: Lose a bank opportunity; deepen trust.

encounters.opening: The buyer waits outside the legitimate queue, annoyed that Aatami arrived before she invented a reason to be there.

choices.label: Complete the first sale
choices.forecast: Gain €68 and price history; the route becomes visible.

choices.label: Trade margin for an introduction
choices.forecast: Gain €55 and the first runner lead.

choices.label: Keep walking with the queue
choices.forecast: Preserve stock; lose the current quote.

encounters.opening: The runner has already read the timetable, and read Aatami. She asks which one of them is more reliable.

choices.label: Offer €18 per night and no waiting games
choices.forecast: Recruit her with a clear wage and a promise she will remember.

choices.label: Offer €10 and future work
choices.forecast: She joins for one job; loyalty starts low.

choices.label: Pay €8 for the route observation
choices.forecast: Gain intel without recruiting.

encounters.documented_fact: Markka ceased to be legal tender after February 2002 and the fixed conversion rate is 5.94573 markka per euro.
encounters.fiction: This particular staffed counter provides the slice's exchange service.
encounters.opening: A paper clock marks the queue. The teller explains that nostalgia has no exchange-rate bonus.

choices.label: Convert all carried markka
choices.forecast: Receive the fixed euro equivalent; the block and visible visit are the cost.

choices.label: Convert 120 mk
choices.forecast: Keep some dead money for a later family choice.

choices.label: Leave before your number
choices.forecast: Keep the old cash and preserve the block's legitimacy cover only in memory.

choices.label: Buy information — €120
choices.forecast: Confirm a safe description and unlock the Harju range.

choices.label: Risk sabotage — €300

choices.label: Eat, listen, owe a favour

choices.label: Leave
choices.forecast: Keep cash; the uncertain mission remains available.

choices.label: Hire the watcher — €24 per night
choices.forecast: Recruit a watcher and reveal intent more clearly in the coming mission.

choices.label: Pay €10 for the observation
choices.forecast: Gain one-use intent clarity without a wage.

choices.label: Watch the dog instead
choices.forecast: Lower immediate pressure; enter the mission with poorer information.

encounters.opening: The public room closes. In the yard, three relatives disagree about the same invoice at full volume.

choices.label: Hire the muscle — €28 per night
choices.forecast: Recruit muscle; owe the family no extra favour.

choices.label: Buy the repaired bat — €35
choices.forecast: Unlock two-handed close pressure.

choices.label: Take gear against a future favour
choices.forecast: Gain a bat and pipe; the family chooses a later obligation.

choices.label: Keep the relationship in the public room
choices.forecast: No equipment; lower faction entanglement.

choices.forecast: Gain the weapon; transfer the obligation into family leverage.

news.documented: Markka notes and coins ceased to be legal tender after February 2002. The irrevocable conversion rate is 5.94573 markka per euro, and redemption remained available through the Bank of Finland until 29 February 2012.
news.inference: Old cash can still appear in homes and informal payments even though ordinary shops cannot treat it as current money.
news.fiction: The slice's staffed Siltasaari counter and its visibility consequences are fictional gameplay services.
news.arvo_copy: The markka is no longer money at the till. Its value is fixed; recovering that value still requires a journey.

endings.label: A door, not Eden
endings.summary: Pasila becomes financially plausible, but the route map travels with Aatami.

endings.label: One more winter
endings.summary: The family plan survives; the calendar does not. Aatami stays in Kallio longer.

endings.label: A clean address, an unpaid city
endings.summary: The move is possible only by carrying debt and faction obligations forward.

endings.label: The empty portrait
endings.summary: Pasila may be nearer or farther, but one absence becomes part of what the family inherits.

ending.label: The shipment
ending.brief: A container comes off a ship at Sörnäinen. Pay for it, move it, and be somewhere else by morning.

classes.label: Bruiser
classes.verb_note: The target cannot reposition next round.

classes.label: Anchor
classes.verb_note: An adjacent ally takes reduced harm.

classes.label: Blade
classes.verb_note: Ignores soft cover; hits the exposed.

classes.label: Spotter
classes.verb_note: Grants the exact read on a target — the intel the telegraph waits for.

classes.label: Runner
classes.verb_note: Carries an item to an ally anywhere on the board.

classes.label: Watcher
classes.verb_note: Reveals the opposition's intent a round early.

classes.label: Fixer
classes.verb_note: Opens a bloodless exit that would not otherwise be there.

classes.label: Driver
classes.verb_note: Withdraws an ally without the usual cost.

classes.label: Local
classes.verb_note: Turns a piece of the yard into cover the others can use.

aptitude_rules.note: A person is not labelled. Appearance follows the FIRST aptitude; a third widens the skill pool and shallows it, so breadth is a trade against depth rather than a strict gain.

skills.label: Hold them there
skills.note: A pinned target loses its guard as well as its footing.

skills.label: No room
skills.note: Enemies adjacent to your target cannot reposition either.

skills.label: Wind-up
skills.note: Skip a round to hit for double. Everyone can see you doing it.

skills.label: Wall
skills.note: You count as hard cover for whoever is behind you.

skills.label: Take it
skills.note: Absorb the harm aimed at an adjacent ally.

skills.label: Planted
skills.note: Nothing repositions you — not a shove, not a blast, not the police.

skills.label: In the gap
skills.note: Extra harm against anyone standing in cover.

skills.label: Quick hands
skills.note: You act first when tempo ties.

skills.label: Bleed
skills.note: A hit takes a little more the following round, whatever else happens.

skills.label: Steady hand
skills.note: Ignore the first cover in the lane.

skills.label: Aimed
skills.note: You always have the exact read on your own target.

skills.label: One in the air
skills.note: Fire to scatter: no harm, everyone in the lane loses nerve — and the heat rises.

skills.label: Call it
skills.note: Your marked target's aim is read by the whole crew.

skills.label: Shared eyes
skills.note: Allies attacking your marked target ignore soft cover.

skills.label: Watch the hands
skills.note: You see the opposition's intent a round before they commit.

skills.label: Out of the way
skills.note: A shove also breaks a pin.

skills.label: Carry
skills.note: Drag a downed ally one cell. This is how somebody gets out.

skills.label: First there
skills.note: You start the fight one cell further forward than you should be.

skills.label: Backbone
skills.note: Adjacent allies do not rout.

skills.label: Shrug
skills.note: The first hit you take each fight lands softer.

skills.label: Loud
skills.note: Enemies hesitate to close on you. It also makes the night noisier.

skills.label: Hand-off
skills.note: Pass a weapon to any ally on the board.

skills.label: Long legs
skills.note: Move two cells instead of one.

skills.label: No goodbyes
skills.note: Withdrawing costs you nothing.

skills.label: Patterns
skills.note: Read intent two rounds ahead instead of one.

skills.label: Tell
skills.note: You know when somebody is about to break.

skills.label: Count them
skills.note: You know how many are coming if it gets loud, and from which end.

skills.label: Reasonable
skills.note: A bloodless exit is on the table a round earlier.

skills.label: Split the difference
skills.note: Somebody who stands down leaves their weapon behind.

skills.label: Names
skills.note: Somebody who runs was never here. They do not raise the heat.

skills.label: Engine running
skills.note: Pull an ally out of the fight without the usual cost.

skills.label: Spare keys
skills.note: One of yours on the ground is not taken when the police arrive.

skills.label: Back door
skills.note: You know which end they will come in at, and you chose it.

skills.label: The yard
skills.note: Turn a piece of the place into cover, once.

skills.label: Back way
skills.note: Your crew deploys anywhere in your own band.

skills.label: Who lives here
skills.note: Third parties do not turn on you, even provoked.

skills.label: Shoulder
skills.note: Your pin also moves them one cell. Where they end up is your problem.

skills.label: No mercy
skills.note: Hitting somebody already down finishes it. It is loud, and it is seen.

skills.label: Last one standing
skills.note: While you are the only one of yours upright, you take half of everything.

skills.label: Dig in
skills.note: Stay put a whole round and your cover counts as hard until you move.

skills.label: Two quick
skills.note: Strike twice at half force. Cover eats the first one.

skills.label: Shiv
skills.note: You are never unarmed. There is always something.

skills.label: Suppress
skills.note: Nobody in the lane repositions next round, including yours.

skills.label: Hold fire
skills.note: Skip the round and the next shot cannot be intercepted by anything soft.

skills.label: Second pair of eyes
skills.note: Your mark survives your own downing. Somebody else took over watching.

skills.label: Grab them
skills.note: Shove an ally instead of an enemy. They will not thank you.

skills.label: Hold the line
skills.note: Allies adjacent to you cannot be shoved.

skills.label: Pockets
skills.note: You can carry one more thing than anybody else.

skills.label: Bad feeling
skills.note: You know one round early when it is about to get loud enough to bring somebody.

skills.label: Owe me
skills.note: Somebody who stands down is remembered as owing you.

skills.label: Side street
skills.note: Withdrawing takes an adjacent ally with you.

skills.label: Everyone knows
skills.note: Heat rises more slowly here. It is your street.
